answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the horizon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Every claim climbs the nebula of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the thread re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
